title: 3038. Maximum Number of Operations With the Same Score I

examples.explanation: We can perform the first operation with the score 3 + 2 = 5. After this operation, nums = [1,4,5]. We can perform the second operation as its score is 4 + 1 = 5, the same as the previous operation. After this operation, nums = [5]. As there are fewer than two elements, we can't perform more operations.

We can perform the first operation with the score 1 + 5 = 6. After this operation, nums = [3,3,4,1,3,2,2,3]. We can perform the second operation as its score is 3 + 3 = 6, the same as the previous operation. After this operation, nums = [4,1,3,2,2,3]. We cannot perform the next operation as its score is 4 + 1 = 5, which is different from the previous scores.
